name: Runey
soft_passes: #2 optically centred but runs large; descender leg near mask edge, margins ~11%
#4 letterform survives 16px but chrome bevel/gloss smears to a flat gray blob
#5 bevel and gloss share a top source, but a baked cast shadow adds a second depth cue
#8 planes order sensibly yet coherence relies on baked bevel/shadow the platform forbids
#11 one ownable device (the running-R), undercut by generic glossy-black + chrome template
failures: #1 mask — art pre-masked into its own rounded-rect (corners alpha 0) with a baked top rim highlight; fights the macOS 26 system squircle (double-round / clipped rim)
#10 variant robustness — flat pre-rendered PNG with baked gloss/bevel on a solid black field; cannot recompose into dark/clear/tinted glass, would double the system specular

palette.background: ramp #313131->#000000 (baked glossy specular band upper-third, peak ~#3E3E3E)

light_model: top-down; beveled chrome lit from top (white top face -> dark under-edge), baked glossy specular sheen across upper third, short soft baked cast shadow beneath glyph; specular pre-baked, not system-applied
layer_stack: pre-masked squircle envelope with baked top rim highlight
beveled chrome R monogram (white top face + silver body + dark bevel)
devices: running-R monogram (open bowl, striding leg — subject-echo of the name, reused as in-app sidebar logo)
baked gloss dome (pre-rendered specular sheen, iOS-6-era)
beveled chrome letterform (white top face, dark under-edge)
pre-masked squircle envelope with baked edge rim (defect-device)
rhymes_hint: glossy-skeuomorphic monogram family — legacy iOS-6-era chrome-initial-on-black logotype icons and app-icon-generator gloss outputs; distinct from Big Sur squircle+tool and from Liquid Glass layered glass
notes: Asset is a genuine 1024x1024 PNG with clean alpha and crisp bevels (measured) — not a resized web render. Mask: corners sampled at alpha 0 and a baked top rim highlight (x-scan y8 ~#8D->#74->#53) confirm the art is delivered pre-masked, not full-bleed square. Brand-coherence gap: brand signature is black + lime/chartreuse green (cover swirl + in-app sidebar renders this exact R in green), but the icon is black + chrome with zero green — under-communicates palette and subject (invoicing/time-tracking). Baked specular/bevel/drop-shadow contradict current HIG ('provide square unmasked layers; let the system apply effects'). Era reads as a legacy glossy app-generator template rather than a knowing retro homage, but skeuomorphic-quote is the closest enum. Letterform carries brand continuity across surfaces even though colour does not.
